author: NanCypress
description: In the game world, precise and convenient operation is the key to victory. The Nanmu Qingcheng key layout is tailor-made for you who seek the ultimate gaming experience. Its clean, clear interface design, paired with a sensible key arrangement, lets both newcomers and veterans get started quickly and enjoy smooth operation. Common keys such as arrow keys, ESC and space are placed in comfortable operating areas, so your fingers move more naturally and you can play for long without fatigue. Unique key combos and functions such as "R + Alt + Shift" and "Ctrl + Plk" help you unlock more efficient actions and handle complex battles with ease. Choose the Nanmu Qingcheng key layout and start a new gaming world, enjoying unprecedented operating thrill and fun.​
